basis: The model directly scores the current capture using the complete user-approved natural-language preference profile. Topic selections revise that same profile instead of creating a separate scoring input. No personal profile is bundled with the plugin.
purpose: Provide an advisory relevance score and disclose human-readable approved profile signals matched by newly captured Raw material. The score must never auto-select, reject, delete, order, or distill content.
rules: The personal profile is the only personal scoring input; manually selected topics become explicit versioned profile signals
Use semantic evidence from the source rather than requiring a literal text occurrence
Do not infer identity or use Vault material outside the current capture and reviewed profile
When a personal profile is active, read its positive and negative preferences, weights, labels, and descriptions in full and apply the weights exactly once
Matched personal preferences are optional human-readable labels and never a validity gate for the score
An invalid recommendation must not invalidate the title, category, preview, or capture
Explain the score in one concise sentence and keep a neutral score when no approved profile signal matches

rubric.0-39: Weak fit or low-signal material with little reusable value
rubric.40-59: Some relevance but limited evidence, novelty, or practical depth
rubric.60-79: Useful and aligned material worth reviewing
rubric.80-100: Strongly aligned, evidence-rich, reusable material with clear practical value
